title: 第5章 修炼飞火弹第6章 二哥叶兴怀
content_zh:
快速进食完毕的叶非凡来到父母的房门前。
“咚...咚…咚。”
“父亲，母亲，你们在吗？“
“是非凡吗？快进来吧。“
听见母亲的声音后，叶非凡就推开门，进入房内，只见父母正坐在桌旁，桌上还摆放着4盘食物，有荤有素，碗里还有一半的米饭，看来父亲和母亲正在吃饭。
“非凡，我和你父亲正在吃晚饭，你也来一起吃点吧。“母亲孙素素温柔的看着叶非凡说道。
“我刚刚吃过了才过来的，我还以为你们都不用吃饭了，就先吃了东西才来的。”叶非凡看着父母说道。
“你在说什么胡话，我们不吃饭，难道你想看到我和你母亲饿死啊“叶虎听到叶非凡说的话有点无语。
“可是父亲您都练气十二重了，按理来说应该不怎么需要吃饭了啊。“
“我是可以一定时间内不用吃饭，但你母亲还需要啊，她只是个普通人，每天还是得按时吃饭的，我呢，就陪着你母亲一起吃吃，免得你母亲一个人有点孤单。“
“啊？母亲不是修炼者吗？“听到叶虎的话，叶非凡大为吃惊。
“你母亲只是城里普通家庭的女儿，和我结婚后，也没有灵根，无法修炼，她身上一点灵气都没有，你应该感受的到吧”
“额……我平常的确在母亲身上感受不到灵气，我以为是因为我本身修为低微的原因，而且平常母亲待我都很温柔，还以为是特意有收敛身体的修炼气息。“
叶虎看着面前的儿子，又气又笑。
“你想太多了，在你醒来后，我们的确没有跟你说过你母亲没有修为这个事情，不过这个也不重要，你的术法选好了吗？“
“可是母亲是普通人的话……“叶非凡看着母亲温柔的眼神，将准备要说出去的话吞入了口中”母亲是普通人的话，那寿命也就不到100岁，而父亲您已经练气12重，等以后到达筑起期的话，寿元肯定会有大幅的上涨，这到时候不就阴阳两隔了。“
原本叶非凡是想这么说的，但还好及时停住了，看着眼前恩爱的父母，他意识到这的确是一个很大的问题，可能父亲叶虎和母亲孙素素有考虑过这个问题，也可能暂时没有想这个问题，但绝不是现在的叶非凡能够聊的话题。
“哎呀，非凡你别站着啊，来，坐着说，让我也听听“孙素素拉着叶非凡的手，让他坐到自己的旁边。
“嗯，术法我已经选好了，选的是‘飞火弹’，这个看起来比较简单实用，而且灵气消耗也不高。“叶非凡坐在孙素素旁边有点不自在，不过还是认真的告知父亲母亲自己的选择。
“‘飞火弹’么，也可以，好多人初次学习术法都是选择的这个，我之前也有学习这个术法，这术法修炼起来不太难，说起来这门术法还有个小窍门，原本这术法是单手释放的，但你练习的时候可以分别使用不同的手释放，等两只手都熟练之后，对战之时，可以分别用不同的手连续释放，能够短时间内快速释放多枚‘飞火弹’，增强你的攻击力。“叶虎听到叶非凡的话后，也给出了一点点自己的建议。

听到父亲叶虎的话后，叶非凡也明白了这个意思，一般修仙者都是人站的直挺挺的，单手放在后腰，一只手指向前方，并且大拇指、小拇指、无名指向掌内弯曲，食指和中指笔直指向目标，然后释放术法，随着微风将长发向后吹起，整个画面就显得很帅气，很修仙。
而叶虎说道双手释放的话，整个人的气质就会变得非常的粗犷，就像电视剧中，单手持枪的都是帅气人物的设定，而双手持双枪连发的都是猛汉或者莽夫的设定，不够修仙，简直不敢想象修仙大能们双手拿双枪互怼的场景，画风都不对了。
但叶非凡也有点纠结，到底是选择帅呢还是选择猛呢？
“算了，成年人还选啥，都要了，反正优先选帅的，实在是被打的不行了，要没命了，那咱就玩猛的。“
想通之后，叶非凡对父亲说道。
“谢谢父亲，我明白了，那我明日就按照您说的这个方式练习‘飞火弹’。“
看着父子二人讨论完术法学习的事情，孙素素笑着说道。
“好了，好了，咱们这饭还没有吃完，要不非凡你也加一点吧，平常都是看你刻苦修炼，咱们一家人也很少坐在一起吃饭了。“
“好，那我就在加一点，刚好之前也没有吃饱。“叶非凡想到孙素素不能修炼的事情后，还是选择试图融入这份亲情当中。
……
和父母吃完晚饭后，叶非凡回到房中，感受着体内还存有的聚气丹药力，便继续修炼秋叶功。
content_en:
After finishing his meal quickly, Ye Feifan came to his parents' door.
"Boom...boom...boom."
"Father, mother, are you there?"
"Is it extraordinary? Come in."
After hearing his mother's voice, Ye Feifan opened the door and entered the room. He saw his parents sitting at the table. There were four plates of food on the table, including meat and vegetables. There was half of the rice in the bowl. It seemed that his father and mother were eating.
"Feifan, your father and I are having dinner, please come and have some too." Mother Sun Susu looked at Ye Feifan tenderly and said.
"I just came here after eating. I thought you didn't need to eat anymore, so I just came here after eating." Ye Feifan looked at his parents and said.
"What nonsense are you talking about? We won't eat. Do you want to see your mother and I starve to death?" Ye Hu was speechless when he heard what Ye Feifan said.
"But father, you have already reached the twelfth level of Qi training. Logically speaking, you shouldn't need to eat much."
"I don't have to eat for a certain period of time, but your mother still needs it. She is just an ordinary person and she still has to eat on time every day. As for me, I will eat with your mother to prevent your mother from being lonely."
"Ah? Isn't my mother a cultivator?" Ye Feifan was shocked when he heard Ye Hu's words.
"Your mother is just the daughter of an ordinary family in the city. After marrying me, she has no spiritual roots and cannot practice. She has no spiritual energy at all. You should be able to feel it."
"Um... I usually don't feel the aura from my mother. I thought it was because of my low cultivation level. Also, my mother usually treats me very gently. I thought it was because she had the cultivation aura to restrain my body."
Ye Hu looked at his son in front of him, angry and laughing at the same time.
"You are thinking too much. After you woke up, we did not tell you that your mother had no cultivation level, but this is not important. Have you chosen your spell?"
"But if my mother were an ordinary person..." Ye Feifan looked at his mother's gentle eyes and swallowed what he was about to say. "If my mother were an ordinary person, her lifespan would be less than 100 years old. And father, you have already practiced Qi for the 12th level. When you reach the Qi Qi stage in the future, your longevity will definitely increase significantly. By then, there will be a separation between yin and yang."
Ye Feifan originally wanted to say this, but luckily he stopped in time. Looking at the loving parents in front of him, he realized that this was indeed a big problem. Maybe his father Ye Hu and mother Sun Susu had considered this issue, or maybe they had not thought about it for the time being, but it was definitely not a topic that Ye Fan could talk about now.
"Oh, Feifan, don't stand there, come on, sit down and talk, let me listen too." Sun Susu took Ye Feifan's hand and asked him to sit next to her.
"Well, I have already chosen the technique, and I chose the 'Flying Fire Bomb'. This one seems relatively simple and practical, and the spiritual energy consumption is not high." Ye Feifan was a little uncomfortable sitting next to Sun Susu, but he still told his father and mother seriously about his choice.
"'Flying Fire Bomb', that's fine too. Many people choose this when learning the technique for the first time. I have also learned this technique before. It is not difficult to practice. Speaking of this technique, there is a little trick. Originally, this technique is released with one hand, but you can use it separately when practicing. Use different hands to release. After both hands are proficient, you can use different hands to release continuously during the battle. You can quickly release multiple 'flying fire bombs' in a short period of time to enhance your attack power. "After Ye Hu heard Ye Feifan's words, he also gave some suggestions of his own.
After hearing what his father Ye Hu said, Ye Feifan also understood the meaning. Generally, immortal cultivators stand upright, with one hand on the back, one finger pointing forward, and the thumb, little finger, and ring finger bent in the palm. The index finger and middle finger point straight at the target, and then release the spell.The breeze blows the long hair back, making the whole picture look very handsome and immortal.
And Ye Hu said that if you release your hands, your whole temperament will become very rough. Just like in TV series, those who hold a gun in one hand are all handsome characters, while those who hold two guns in both hands are fierce men or reckless men. They are not immortal enough. I can't imagine the scene of immortal cultivators fighting each other with two guns in both hands. The style of the painting is wrong.
But Ye Feifan is also a bit confused. Should he choose to be handsome or fierce?
"Forget it, you have to choose whatever you want as an adult. Anyway, I'll give priority to the handsome ones. If I'm really beaten to death and I'm going to die, then let's play hard."
After thinking about it, Ye Feifan said to his father.
"Thank you, father. I understand. Then I will practice the 'Flying Fire Bomb' in the way you said tomorrow."
After watching the father and son discuss the matter of learning magic, Sun Susu said with a smile.
"Okay, okay, we haven't finished our meal yet, why don't you add a little more to Feifan? Normally, I see you practicing hard, and our family rarely sits down to eat together."
"Okay, then I'll add a little more. I haven't eaten enough before." After Ye Feifan thought about Sun Susu's inability to practice, he still chose to try to integrate into this family relationship.
…
After dinner with his parents, Ye Feifan returned to his room, feeling the power of the Qi Gathering Pill still in his body, and continued practicing the Autumn Leaf Kung Fu.
